ValidationRule.description: The merge audit cannot be changed after creation. The Surviving HCP lookup is excluded (a later merge of that HCP moves it); the JSON long-text fields are read-only for every permission set and only written by Apex.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED(Master_Contact_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Merged_Contact_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Merged_Contact_Name__c), ISCHANGED(Related_Summary__c), ISCHANGED(Merged_By__c), ISCHANGED(Merged_At__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The merge audit record cannot be changed.
